36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
173758: Rentarou is an extremely kind and thoughtful person who loves all of his many girlfriends very dearly, often to a scarily self-sacrificing degree. Before he began his days as a high school student, Rentarou had been rejected a total of 100 times.
173759: Girlfriend No. 001 Hakari is described as a "clumsily calculative" lady. She is often planning and plotting to achieve her goals which may or may not go as planned due to her clumsiness.
173761: Girlfriend No. 003 Shizuka is rather timid especially given her rather quiet or mute voice which makes her rather distant from other people. However, ever since she met Rentarou she has become braver, even willing to sacrifice her own safety to help Hakari out.
173762: Girlfriend No. 004 Nano is practical to a fault, obsessed with solving a problem in the most efficient way possible no matter what. Nano is the smartest among the girls.
173763: Girlfriend No. 005 Kusuri is energetic and ingenuitive; she is capable of creating a drug for almost anything. She doesn't tend to be concerned about the dangers of the drugs she makes, and will often happily force them upon others or take them herself without hesitation.
173812: Girlfriend No. 006 Hakari's mother. Hahari appears as a very mature and sophisticated woman, until she sees something cute. She has an uncontrollable love for cute things, including children, as well as Rentarou and his family.
182333: Girlfriend No. 007 Kurumi absolutely loves food and possesses an extremely high metabolism. As such, she's almost constantly hungry, and she grows extremely cranky if she isn't eating the certain food that she happens to be craving for at the moment.
188521: Girlfriend No. 008 The personal maid of Hahari Hanazono. Mei is polite and proper, rarely showing strong emotions. She is loyal to Hahari above all else, and is unlikely to do anything unless given permission or ordered to by Hahari specifically.
190912: Girlfriend No. 009 Iku loves baseball, to the point of spending hours recruiting for her team when it's on the verge of being disbanded. She is determined to do her best no matter what; because of this she's described as the embodiment of "stoicism" by Rentarou.
197921: Girlfriend No. 010 Mimimi is very haughty and narcissistic, constantly complimenting herself and talking about her beauty. Despite her appearance of a naturally-beautiful rich girl, Mimimi actually works incredibly hard to provide for herself and keep herself beautiful.
205771: Girlfriend No. 011 Meme is extremely shy, to the point of wearing masks to hide her face in order to avoid drawing attention to herself. She strives to keep her face hidden no matter what. Meme also enjoys knitting, and spends time knitting a lot of little stuffed animals.
214580: Girlfriend No. 012 Chiyo is reliable and tidy which led to her becoming class president. But, she secretly dislikes the high expectations others place on her. When she takes her glasses off, she becomes anxious and begins crying uncontrollably.
254931: Girlfriend No. 015 Momi is somewhat stoic and blunt, blatantly admitting to her love of massaging (especially women) without concern for how perverse it may sound. She loves touching things, especially things that are soft, including women and character-based mousepads.
284129: Girlfriend No. 020 She is the granddaughter of the previous head maid of the Hanazono household who desired to become a maid herself after meeting Mei. She idolizes Mei and is her self-proclaimed little sister and is highly protective of her.
306697: The god of a local shrine who informs Rentarou that due to his constant prayers to his shrine, and partially due to him being distracted when watching Castle in the Sky, he overly blessed Rentarou to meet 100 soulmates during his high school life.
306701: The boy with a terminal illness whom Hahari had fallen in love with when she was a schoolgirl. Before he died, Hahari was artificially inseminated using his sperm at the age of 13, which led to the birth of Hakari.
316628: Rentarou's friend up until his middle school graduation.
327388: The girl who rejected main character Rentarou Aijou's 100th love confession.
357218: Pitcher of Jurassic High School's baseball team
357219: Catcher for Jurassic High School's baseball team
